interactions.description: 页面加载携带 token 查询发票与订单信息
interactions.securityEnforcement: Token mandatory, 401 on missing, 403 on invalid/expired, 404 on missing record (no auto-init)

interactions.description: 抬头类型切换（企业/个人单选）
interactions.clientVerification: DOM event handler selectType('COMPANY'/'PERSONAL') toggles taxNoGroup display and placeholder dynamically

interactions.description: 提交发票抬头、税号及接收方式
interactions.securityEnforcement: Requires valid token, sets token_used_at, transitions to TITLE_SUBMITTED, sanitizes PII in logs

interactions.description: 提交按钮防抖禁用与等待反馈
interactions.clientVerification: btnSubmit.disabled set to true with '正在提交...' loading text immediately on click; re-enabled on error

interactions.description: 发票文件下载链接安全协议校验
interactions.clientVerification: Protocol whitelist enforces startsWith http://, https://, / and rejects javascript: or HTML injections
